question: NenzMail per-inbox byte size and per-message byte cap are not stated on any first-party page; should this record stay qualified-with-caveat until a probe measures an inbox cap?
why: The question asked for inbox size and message size cap. The API docs, FAQ, home page and official SDK pages state no byte number for either; recording a number would invent it. The archive capture and SDK pages quote only a 1-hour retention and a 20-per-hour outbound send rate.
